applicability: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, four B300, BF16, native eight steps
Only the source ledger's individual trials and controls
limitations: The final campaign PASS does not qualify each rejected direction
Exploratory trial timings are not additive gains or causal comparisons
No experiment was rerun for this extraction
attribution: Historical issue #3 optimization ledger; revisit checks are current diagnostic suggestions

findings.direction: Require full-image parity for fused Q/K RMSNorm and complex RoPE
findings.reason: The H3 operator checks passed, yet its complete images failed and the change was reverted. The later kept H10/H13 implementations were different.
findings.revisit_when: Reproduce the reduction, complex FMA ordering and BF16 materialization, then check native full images after the operator comparisons.

findings.direction: Pair a packed Q/K/V 5D layout with full request timing
findings.reason: H1 passed quality but the exploratory exchange was discarded. The ledger’s standalone trial does not resolve the cost of layout staging or copies.
findings.revisit_when: For a changed topology or layout, keep the comparison matched and account for staging, transfers and request time separately.

findings.direction: Measure complete graph replay before promoting projection or norm/RoPE changes
findings.reason: H6 and H7 were removed after failing to produce a material end-to-end gain. H7 includes capture/replay and copy costs that matter to the final decision.
findings.revisit_when: Test a materially different capture boundary or buffer lifetime against a paired full request. Account for capture, replay and copies.

findings.direction: Verify critical-path time for broadcast scales and empty concatenation removal
findings.reason: The H14/H16 decode scale/gate broadcast and empty concatenation changes were removed or reverted because the trials did not demonstrate a benefit.
findings.revisit_when: Profile the intended configuration to see whether these operations are on its critical path, and retain the matched service control.

findings.direction: Treat H17 and the noisy H13 run as host-confounded readings
findings.reason: Concurrent diagnostics and host load were observed during these attempts, so the timing difference does not isolate the code change.
findings.revisit_when: Repeat the same request on a qualified host without overlapping diagnostics.
findings.bounds: The cited exploratory H17 run and noisy H13 attempt.

findings.direction: Carry a compiled launch API probe through full-pipeline integration before judging gain
findings.reason: H18 improved host enqueue in a diagnostic. It never went through the complete pipeline, so the resulting service overhead was not measured.
findings.revisit_when: Confirm actual dispatch and full-image correctness in the integrated candidate, then measure request time.
